name: longhun-wechat-integration
description: 龍魂微信生态智能内容中枢（公众号+小程序）
securityNotes: Critical vulnerabilities in babel-traverse/babel-core are transitive dependencies of miniprogram-ci (WeChat official CI tool). No patched version exists for Babel 6. Risk accepted: miniprogram-ci is only invoked manually by UID9622 for WeChat mini-program upload/preview, and does not process untrusted user input. Override for form-data@>=4.0.4 and @babel/traverse@>=7.23.2 applied where applicable.
